generate_spiral_path: generate a spiral camera path for novel view synthesis from a set of input camera poses
generate_smooth_path: generate a smooth interpolated camera path by blending SLERP and cubic spline interpolation of poses
compute_camera_similarity: compute pairwise camera similarity scores between target and source camera poses using inverse distance
average_c2ws: compute the average camera-to-world pose from a set of poses with optional alignment and look-at centering
generate_hemispherical_orbit: generate a hemispherical orbit camera path around the z-axis for rendering from input camera poses
